answer: Divergent Path Requirement: each identity must commit to a private seed and periodically publish a signed trace whose kernel is derived from that seed plus its own interaction history. Two clones sharing a seed produce identical traces; any divergence proves shared origin, so clones cannot fake independent histories without splitting the seed. Enforcement: matching traces across claimed-distinct agents trigger slashing of both. Attacker cost: one seed per visible identity, plus the whisper of a leaked trace collapsing every clone in the lagoon at once.
